The provided solution correctly finds common elements using nested loops and removes matched elements from the second array to handle duplicates. However, it uses an extra list (`common_elements`) to store the result, which may violate the "without using any extra data structures" constraint if interpreted strictly (i.e., constant auxiliary space). The solution also modifies the input array `arr2`, which could be undesirable. The time complexity is O(n*m), and no alternative approaches (e.g., sorting with two pointers) or complexity analysis are discussed. The answer is functional but lacks depth and full adherence to the constraint.

Rating: [[5]]
